## 3. Rendering-surface inventory (a lead-generator, not a certified census)

Method: for each inventoried `.tsx` under `app/` and `components/`, list its import specifiers that resolve into `lib/registry`, `lib/db`, `lib/ask`, `lib/sources`, `lib/coverage` or `lib/routing` (via `@/` aliases or relative paths). **Limits, stated:** this sees direct imports only — a component fed civic data through props, a context, or an intermediate module does not appear; a type-only import does. It is a lead-generator for where civic data reaches a screen, not a certified census.

What the six lib areas serve:

- `lib/registry` — divisions, bodies, rosters: who governs a place.
- `lib/db` — the Drizzle schema and queries over the Postgres serving tables.
- `lib/ask` — the grounded Ask route: evidence packs, votes, local finance.
- `lib/sources` — the ingestion adapters (one directory per external source).
- `lib/coverage` — the honest coverage statements per point and body.
- `lib/routing` — question routing and the ask-box classifier.

## 6. The gate set

Method: imported from `GATES` in `scripts/gates.mjs` (the module the parity test anchors to `.github/workflows/build-check.yml`). The count is derived from the array, never hardcoded.

**12 gate(s):**

| id | CI job | command | why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lint` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm lint` | the gate that was missing — it is why RO04 exists |
| `tsc` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` | a fresh-checkout type check, never behind a build |
| `governance:check` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm governance:check` | the ledger is the canonical store, and a generated view that disagrees with its generator is not law (RULING 92, RULING 102) |
| `orchestration:check` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm orchestration:check` | independent executable work serialized with nothing checkable behind it is a process defect (RULING 190) |
| `method:check` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm method:check` | the cumulative route knowledge is what every later jurisdiction inherits; a broken store reads as a project that knows nothing |
| `assert:browser` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm run assert:browser` | RULING 113 — observe the step's product at the step |
| `test` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm test` | the suite, which is every other protection in this repo |
| `db:gate` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm exec tsx scripts/db-shipping-gate.mts` | a deploy may not cross its own migrations — 0021 and 0022 shipped ahead of the schema |
| `release:freeze` | gates (test · lint · tsc) | `pnpm exec tsx scripts/release-freeze-gate.mts` | a production-changing release may not ship on top of a DEGRADED production integrity reading |
| `build` | build (default) | `pnpm run build` | the command netlify.toml gives Netlify |
| `test:bundle` | build (default) | `pnpm run test:bundle` | scans the built chunks — needs the build above |
| `build:standalone` | build (standalone) | `pnpm run build` | what the Netlify Next runtime plugin actually builds |

## 9. Method knowledge registry

Method: `data/method/knowledge.json`, the canonical route store (types in `lib/method/knowledge.ts`). Assertion classes are the four of `lib/method/claims.ts` — ROUTE_EXISTENCE (A), ROUTE_OUTCOME (B), COVERAGE_CLAIM (C), DERIVED_CONCLUSION (D). A route with no declared claims renders UNCLASSIFIED — nobody declared a class, which is NOT a claim that the entry concludes nothing. Last-verified is the latest recorded outcome date, else the learned date. Uncapped; version and counts derived from the store, never hardcoded.

## 14. ControlPlaneRepository providers

Method: the provider files under `lib/control-plane/repository/`, with each provider's own `durable:` declaration extracted from its source.

**2 provider(s):**

- `lib/control-plane/repository/file-store.ts` — `durable: true`. the durable filesystem store — CURRENTLY AUTHORITATIVE. Control-plane work state persists under the committed-file substrate (the same class as data/workstate/), deliberately not Postgres (which is the reader-serving substrate and gated by db:gate).
- `lib/control-plane/repository/memory.ts` — `durable: false`. the in-process double — pins the same rules over a Map for the concurrency suite; it does not survive the process and durability tests refuse it.

The crash-recovery and durable-runtime suites (`tests/control-plane-crash-recovery.test.ts`, `tests/control-plane-durable-runtime.test.ts`) run against the FILE store; the concurrency-rule suite runs against the double.
